paragraphs.text: Several Magic: The Gathering webcomics , online comic strips, have been published in the past. They can be divided in the canon planeswalker origin stories published by Wizards of the Coast on Magicthegathering.com on the one hand, and Magic related content on fan sites on the other hand.

Between 2007 and 2011, Wizards of the Coast published a series of webcomics on their website, under the generic name of "Planeswalkers". They are usually referred to as "the webcomics". Below is a comprehensive list. Most of these have been bundled by Wizards of the Coast in Path of the Planeswalker and Path of the Planeswalker II , and are considered canon .
Several fan sites also have published comic strips online. These are not canon.
